## Summary
Describe the change and its user impact.

## Modules touched
- [ ] Web
- [ ] Parcels
- [ ] Groceries
- [ ] Couriers / Dispatch
- [ ] Database migrations
- [ ] Audit / Observability

## Verification
- [ ] Relevant tests and local builds passed
- [ ] Authorization and negative cases considered
- [ ] No real personal data or secrets added
- [ ] API contracts and docs updated
- [ ] Migration/rollback plan provided (if applicable)
- [ ] Screenshots supplied for UI changes

## Release and operational risk
List dependencies, feature flags, monitoring changes, rollback plan and whether this changes a production gate.

## Review
Request review from the owner of each affected module before merge.
